component.name: EasyRestore
component.summary: Restore an iPhone or iPad from an IPSW on Linux

description.p: EasyRestore guides you through restoring, updating, or erasing an iPhone or iPad using an IPSW firmware file — without using a terminal.
It vendors a pinned libimobiledevice stack, verifies firmware integrity before restore, and uses PolicyKit for privileged USB operations.
Tester AppImage release with bundled libimobiledevice stack and host USB setup notes.
Initial development preview: wizard shell, IPSW verify, helper restore path.
